senses.gloss:
[आ-तुप्-घञ् पृषो° टत्वम् [[Tv.]]] 
__1 Pride, self-conceit, arrogance; साटोपम् proudly, in a stately or majestic manner, frequently used as a stage-direction. 
__2 Swelling, spreading, expanding, puffing; Prov. फटाटोपो भयंकरः; said also of clouds, अद्यापि साटोपा मेघा द्दश्यन्ते [[Pt. 1]]; [[Śi. 3. 74.]] 
__3 Flatulence (in the belly).
